$comment: Birds in the sky (#10630): drawn, not simulated, and nothing is seeded or saved. A flight crosses a circle of reachMetres around the player, passing it by missMetres, and carries on past the far side until every bird is beyond reachMetres of where the player is now. A speck can still be seen at that range, so a bird grows from nothing at reachMetres to its size fadeMetres further in. Distances are metres, speeds metres a second, hours of the day, turn and flap times seconds.
